bridge_rules: June cash/debt/exact common shares are matched in date.
Default equity allocation blocked; use explicit policy, not zeros.
Operating lease liabilities are not subtracted because operating rent remains in EBIT.
Finance leased asset additions are deducted as economic capex, finance debt separately deducted only under explicit policy.
No real estate/ROU/franchisee systemwide asset add-on: operating cash flows already capture their use.
No second deduction for future rent relief/capital support; each is charged once in core.
No buyback cash inflow or free share shrinkage in FCFF.
No affiliate carrying-value addition while leaving equity-method earnings in EBIT.
Full SBC cash replacement stays in operating forecast. Existing-award reserve must be incremental to compensation already charged.
not_a_funding_model: The DCF values operating cash flows; it does not certify debt refinancing, annual dividends/buybacks, daily liquidity, or cash fungibility. Optional allocations are arithmetic illustrations only; no funding-certified admission.

observed_distribution_funding_context.interpretation: CFO less cash capex compared with discretionary distributions is a limited observed cash-flow check, not FCFF or a solvency, refinancing or dividend-safety test. Other investing, financing and FX flows are not included in this residual. No projected distributions are assumed in the operating DCF.
